content.thinking:
The change log timestamp of 16:58:38 doesn't quite match what I'm seeing in the actual logs, which show the flag already ramping at 16:53 with a partial split of 140 off to 60 on—suggesting gradual rollout began earlier than the recorded change event. The logged timestamp may just mark when the flag was fully switched on rather than the start of the rollout.

The error onset at 16:53 aligns precisely with this partial flag rollout, and the ValueError in monthly_statement.py:627 is consistent with a max() call hitting an empty iterable—a bad code path exposed by the flag rather than a code change itself. This points clearly to a feature-flag-toggle root cause for the monthly-spend-feature flag, transitioning from off to on during the ramp, and I have high confidence in this diagnosis.
